summary: Unnamed backpacker overdue from a permitted backcountry trip in Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP (planned exit Saturday); rangers found his car still at the trailhead Sunday morning and began searching his intended route; his body was located Tuesday ~1,000 ft below the South Rim, an apparent fatal fall; NPS coordinating recovery with the Montrose County Sheriff's Office.
location: South Rim, Black Canyon of the Gunnison National Park
responding_agency: National Park Service; Montrose County Sheriff's Office
notes: Crested Butte News, April 10, 2013 (parent-opened); backpacker held a backcountry permit indicating a planned exit on Saturday; search began Sunday after rangers found his car at the trailhead; body located Tuesday Apr 9. Row dated by the planned-exit Saturday, Apr 6, 2013 (Saturday-verified), per the id 302 (Ryan Wood Moss, 2016) overdue-Saturday precedent; the fall itself is undated. Identity withheld at publication; no follow-up naming the victim found. Run 1021 chunk A.
